title: Author the derived-state-coherence project invariant
description:
Author the registry-first `derived-state-coherence` invariant in this repository's invariant registry and render it through the existing project projection into guidance, leaving every adopter-facing surface untouched. This is the sole leaf accountable for container criterion REQ-07.

## Background

Derived-state coherence receives its own invariant rather than broadening `single-source-prose`: each semantic mutation derives coupled materializations from one final repository view and publishes them recoverably. The invariant is project-local architecture guidance, registry-first per `@/charter/D-6`.

## What to build

- Author `derived-state-coherence` in this repository's `.jit/invariants.toml` with advisory classification, stating that each semantic mutation derives coupled materializations from one final view and publishes them recoverably.
- Render it through the existing `[projection.*]` project projection into project guidance via `jit project render`.
- Leave `single-source-prose` unchanged and focused on prose authority and projection/citation. Do not add the new invariant to generated init scaffolding or the dogfood profile's adopter-owned invariant registry.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: derived-state-coherence exists in this repository's .jit/invariants.toml with advisory classification and renders through the existing project projection into guidance.
- [hard] REQ-02: single-source-prose is unchanged and the new invariant is absent from generated init scaffolding and the dogfood profile's adopter-owned invariant registry.

## Constraints

- Registry-first per `@/charter/D-6`; advisory classification unless a real resolvable enforcement binding is added.
- Project-local only: adopter scaffolding and profile-installed registries remain byte-identical.

Blast radius: this repository's invariant registry and its rendered projection. See `dev/active/cdc840ad-plan.md` §2 (project-local invariant and public fit).
